_doc: NO-SWALLOW-1: 'Never swallow an error' (agents/AGENTS.md) as a check. A bare `except:` in Python is banned outright. `2>/dev/null` is counted per file against a shrink-only baseline: a file may lose occurrences, never gain one, and a new file starts at 0. Checked by scripts/lint_swallow.py (tests/foundation/test_noswallow.py, run by the foundation tests step of checks). Never raise a baseline number to pass; log the error instead.
